title: hours-per-week
text: hours-per-week 每周工作时长，小时。 数据类型 int64 示例值

title: education-num
text: education-num 教育程度的有序数值编码，不直接等同于个人实际受教育年数。 数据类型 int64 示例值

title: marital-status
text: marital-status 婚姻状况。 数据类型 object 示例值 Divorced, Married-AF-spouse, Married-civ-spouse, Married-spouse-absent, Never-married, Separated, Widowed

title: workclass
text: workclass 雇佣类型。 数据类型 object 示例值 Federal-gov, Local-gov, Never-worked, Private, Self-emp-inc, Self-emp-not-inc, State-gov, Without-pay

title: income_gt_50k
text: income_gt_50k 派生二元变量：原始 income 为 >50K 时等于 1，<=50K 时等于 0。均值是样本中超过门槛的比例。 数据类型 int64 示例值

title: occupation
text: occupation 职业类别。 数据类型 object 示例值 Adm-clerical, Armed-Forces, Craft-repair, Exec-managerial, Farming-fishing, Handlers-cleaners, Machine-op-inspct, Other-service, Priv-house-serv, Prof-specialty, Protective-serv, Sales
